correctness.rationale: For finite symmetric 2-(v,k,lambda) designs with distinct blocks and 2<=k<=v-2, square point-block incidence N has NN^t=(k-lambda)I+lambda J and N1=N^t1=k1; invertibility since 0<lambda<k yields N^tN=(k-lambda)I+lambda J. For any two pebbled elements (including equal and cross-sort pairs), the occurrence of every desired equality/sort/incidence pattern for a third is parameter independent: two distinct points or blocks have lambda common, k-lambda one-sided, and v-2k+lambda=(v-k)(v-k-1)/(v-1)>0 neither incidences; point-block pairs have k-1,v-k or k,v-k-1 choices, all positive. Thus Duplicator preserves atomic relations under any three-pebble move for arbitrary rounds, proving common FO^3 theory without counting, including unary sorts; pure adjacency follows by reduct. Fano lambda1 incidence graph is C4-free, whereas complementary symmetric (7,4,2) design has 4-cycles, yielding a four-variable separating sentence. Independent exact Fano pair-intersection and four-cycle computations confirm boundary; unrestricted logic theorem follows from pair extension identities, not finite examples.
